history.note: Replaced kitchen mixer tap and both flexible tap connectors. Tested, no leaks. 12-month workmanship guarantee.

description: Escape of water from Flat 4 through the kitchen ceiling of Flat 3 (reported by the Flat 3 occupier by phone 19:35 Sat 10/10). Tenant away 9-12 Oct.

history.note: Entered with key holder. Stopcock off. Cause: failed compression joint on the cold feed under the kitchen sink. Joint replaced, water back on, no further leak. 12-month workmanship guarantee.
Landlord Ben Hartley emailed: leak stopped, Flat 3 kitchen ceiling damaged, insurance claim likely on the Hartley Homes block policy.
Swift invoice SPH-20931 £285 paid. Ticket closed.
